notes.title: Aralunis is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
Aralunis is now available! 🎉[previewyoutube="qx9RY_g_HNs;full"][/previewyoutube]
A princess sets out on a journey to save the hero who was mistakenly captured 👑✨
By her side, an untrustworthy guide — obsessed with mushrooms 🍄 and hiding secrets far deeper than they seem... 👀

What starts as a cute and innocent fairy tale quickly strays from the script 📖❌
After all, a princess who only wanted to save a friend… might end up saving the world — or destroying it 💥🌍

The future is in your hands 🕹️
